old_caption: The video captures a dramatic scene where a large metallic cylinder is descending onto a collection of white ceramic bowls. The bowls are stacked on top of each other, with some featuring colorful designs, including a prominent peach illustration and Chinese characters. As the metallic cylinder approaches, it begins to crush the bowls beneath it. The force of the impact causes the bowls to shatter into numerous fragments, sending shards flying outward in all directions. The background is a plain, light-colored wall, which contrasts sharply with the metallic sheen of the cylinder and the delicate white of the broken ceramics. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the central action without any noticeable panning or zooming, allowing viewers to observe the progression of the destruction in detail.

caption: The video captures a close, static shot of a crushing setup, where a large cylindrical metal press head sits above a yellow-and-black striped base. Between them lies a stack of white ceramic bowls decorated with a peach-like fruit and red characters; the upper bowls are already reduced to a jumble of curved shards, while the lowest decorated bowl remains mostly whole. The press head descends only slightly and gradually, narrowing the gap to the shard pile. As it presses, the broken shards shift and compress, ejecting fragments sideways and downward, with a curved white piece tumbling out on the right and fine debris streaking on the left. A crack line persists on the right side of the lower bowl, and small chips break away from its rim over time. The lower bowl stays centered and largely intact, its surface pattern fixed relative to the base throughout.
